name: Paris Saclay Versailles (Toussus-le-Noble)

runway.v: Two runways: 07L/25R 1,100 m x 30 m, 07R/25L 1,050 m x 30 m.

curfew.v: Closed to all traffic 22:30-06:00 local (21:30-05:00 UTC in winter; same local time in summer). Also closed Sundays and holidays 1 Apr-30 Sep, 12:00-15:00 local, except medevac.
curfew.quote: Aérodrome interdit à tout trafic de 2130-0500 (ETE - 1 HR).

customs.v: No flights to or from outside Schengen. Schengen flights only, within customs allowances.

hours.v: Tower 07:00-22:00 local (06:00-21:00 UTC winter). Outside these hours closed to visiting VFR and IFR aircraft unless DSAC Nord allows it.

max_aircraft.v: Closed to aircraft over 12 t MTOW. Jets under IFR must meet noise chapter 3 or 4.
max_aircraft.quote: AD interdit aux ACFT dont la masse au décollage est supérieure à 12 t.

fuel.v: 100LL, Jet A1, Jet SAF, UL Aero Super+. Fuel 07:00-21:00 local (06:00-20:00 UTC winter), to 22:00 local on 4 h notice.
fuel.quote: Carburants : 100 LL - JET A1 - JET SAF - UL AERO SUPER +

handling.v: Commercial assistance listed: Clean Aero Service, Air Affaires Assistance.

notes: Read AIP France AD 2 LFPN in the eAIP of 29 Oct 2026 (page valid from 01 Oct 2026). The AIP now names it Paris Saclay Versailles. Only light jets: 12 t MTOW limit, runways 1,100 m, no non-Schengen flights, no de-icing. AIP times are UTC in winter and one hour earlier in summer, so local times stay the same.
